Clare J: FYI spotted a weird spike of 502s for signed uploads from eu-east yesterday evening. trace id: 0a1b2c
Sanjay: Any commonalities? same route/version?
Clare J: All from the same presigned flow. Looks like frontend sends paths with %2F encoded segs, edge rewrite then does a decode + prefix-strip and finally we preserve Host header. Some backends expect encoded form for validation.
Julie P: Ugh. so rewrite order is decode -> strip -> forward_host_preserve? that would change the string used in sig check.
Sanjay: Exactly. Current pipeline is: normalize_path (percent-decode), apply_prefix_rules, inject_headers, forward. We thought decode first was ok for cache keys.
Clare J: The sig algorithm on storage-service computes HMAC over original url-encoded query+path, so double-decoding breaks it. We should avoid mutating path used for sig.
Julie P: Two options: 1) add keep_original_path flag to the route context and pass both raw and normalized versions to backends; 2) change order to apply prefix-strip before percent-decode when route.has_signature_check == true.
Sanjay: Option 1 seems safer but bigger. Option 2 is smaller but brittle for other features (cache key, routing by decoded segments).
Julie P: Agree. also we need to consider Host header: some upstreams use Host for tenant lookup. If we rewrite Host after path changes we can break routing.
Clare J: Repro steps: curl -v 'https://edge.example.com/prefix%2Fobject?st=xxx&sig=yyy' -> 502; on the storage box logs sig_mismatch: computed on decoded path '/prefix/object'
Sanjay: Minimal patch proposal: introduce route rule boolean `preserve_raw_path_for_signature` default false; when true, we skip percent-decoding for the path that is forwarded to the backend signature check and to any signature-sensitive header injection. It still allows normalized path for internal routing decisions.
Julie P: Can we implement this without changing the core path-normalizer ABI? Maybe stash original_path in request.ctx.original_path and plumb it to header-injector. 
Sanjay: Yep, we can stash at the earliest ingress stage before any mutation. header-injector already reads ctx.* fields. So quick patch is small.
Clare J: Sounds good. also we should add an end-to-end test for presigned uploads where we compare backend-received path vs client-sent raw path.
Julie P: I'll sketch a test harness. two cases: preserve_raw_path_for_signature=true (expect 200) and false (expect sig_mismatch).
deploy-bot: route rule update deployed to staging @ 1954321400 for canary testing :rocket:
Clare J: Running canary now against 5% traffic. I can watch the spike metric.
Sanjay: If canary is clean, let's roll to 50% then 100% tomorrow. Add a note in the release doc about potential interactions with cache-key canonicalization.
Julie P: Also document that this flag is for signature-sensitive flows; default false to avoid surprising behavior for other routes.
Clare J: Thanks all. I'll open the PR and attach the repro logs.
Sanjay: thx. ping when PR ready and i'll review.
